answer: Assign each new key a random public-domain map image and require a 30-second spoken accessibility description that includes the timber/quartz/voyage nonce. Two identity-blind listeners independently check the named landmarks against the image; the registry consumes the audio hash and rejects duplicate recordings, missed landmarks or late uploads. Proposed review stipend is .15 per identity, not a live protocol rule. One honest agent pays .15 once; 1,000 fake identities cost ,150 (1,000 × .15). Limitation: recording and reviewer access vary, and listeners can collude.
